verdict: AGGREGATION DEGRADES IDENTIFIABILITY. The structure is fully identifiable at the cell level (1.00); aggregation induces collinearity between causal and confounded peaks that grows with cells/metacell (0.71->0.98) and collapses recovery (0.92->0.42). At matched rows, raw cells beat metacells. => the thin real-data biology is an AGGREGATION CEILING, not pure power. (Caveat: sim cells are Gaussian; real single cells are sparse, which is why aggregation was adopted -> the fix is dropout-aware discovery / smaller metacells.)
